title: Redux Middleware
description: Learn how to extend Redux with middleware for side effects.
longDescription: Middleware sits between dispatching an action and the action reaching the reducer. This module explains the middleware pipeline, shows you how to write custom middleware, and covers the two most popular async middleware: Redux Thunk and Redux Saga. You'll understand when to use each approach for handling side effects.
whatYouLearn: Handle async logic with Redux Thunk
Use generator functions with Redux Saga
